title: Premium website for 'Baba Farid Tailor' with catalog and online measurement order form

requirements.text: Create a multi-page website with the following sections/pages and navigation: Home, About Us, Catalog, Order Now, and Contact Us. Ensure the header navigation links correctly route/scroll to each section and the active section is visually indicated.

quotes: Sections Needed: Home, About Us (mentioning our expertise in bespoke tailoring), Catalog, Order Now (Form), and Contact Us.

acceptanceCriteria: A header navigation is present on all pages/sections with links for Home, About Us, Catalog, Order Now, Contact Us.
Each nav item takes the user to the correct page/section.
The current page/section is visually highlighted in the navigation.

requirements.text: Implement a top header area that prominently displays the business name "Baba Farid Tailor" and includes a dedicated logo placeholder region intended for a future uploaded custom logo (placeholder should be visually distinct and sized appropriately).

quotes: Header & Logo: Place the business name 'Baba Farid Tailor' prominently in the header. I have a custom logo that I will upload, so please create a dedicated placeholder for it.

acceptanceCriteria: The header shows "Baba Farid Tailor" prominently.
A clearly marked logo placeholder area exists in the header (e.g., a framed box with 'Logo' label) and does not break layout on mobile.
Layout remains responsive across common breakpoints.

requirements.text: Display contact details (Mobile Number and Email ID) clearly in a top bar and/or footer, using placeholder values that can be easily replaced later (e.g., constants/config in the frontend).

quotes: Contact Details: Show my Mobile Number and Email ID clearly in the top bar or the footer section so customers can easily reach me.

acceptanceCriteria: Mobile number and email are visible without needing to navigate away (in top bar and/or footer).
Values are implemented as easily editable placeholders (not hard-coded in multiple locations).
On mobile, the contact details remain readable and do not overlap other elements.

requirements.text: Create a premium 'Catalog' section that showcases the categories: Suits, Shirts, Pants, and Traditional wear. Each category must have a presentable card/tile layout and a way to choose a style that can be used by the Order Now form.

quotes: Service Catalog: Create a 'Catalog' section showcasing different categories like Suits, Shirts, Pants, and Traditional wear.
Online Ordering & Measurements: I need an online order form where customers can select a style from the catalog ...

acceptanceCriteria: Catalog UI shows the four required categories: Suits, Shirts, Pants, Traditional wear.
Each category is displayed as a visually consistent card/tile with a title and brief placeholder description.
A user can select a category/style and proceed to (or prefill) the Order Now form with that selection.
Catalog data is sourced from the backend (not only hard-coded in the UI).

requirements.text: Implement an 'Order Now' page containing an online order form where customers can (1) select a category and style from the catalog and (2) submit their measurements (including at minimum Length, Chest, Waist, Shoulder). Include additional common tailoring measurements as appropriate and provide size-chart guidance in the UI (e.g., a reference table and/or helper text) without requiring user authentication.

quotes: Online Ordering & Measurements: I need an online order form where customers can select a style from the catalog and provide their measurements (Length, Chest, Waist, Shoulder, etc.) based on size charts.

acceptanceCriteria: Order form allows selecting a category and style from the existing catalog list.
Measurements inputs include at least: Length, Chest, Waist, Shoulder (and may include others like Sleeve, Neck, Hip, Inseam).
UI includes size chart guidance (e.g., a small table or expandable panel) and clearly states units (cm/in) with a single chosen unit or a unit selector.
Client-side validation prevents submission when required fields are missing or invalid (e.g., non-numeric measurements).
On submit, the order is stored in the backend and the user sees a confirmation state with an order reference (e.g., order ID).

requirements.text: Create a backend data model and API in the single Motoko actor to: (1) return catalog categories/styles, (2) accept new order submissions containing selected catalog style + customer measurements + basic contact info, and (3) list orders for basic verification/testing purposes (non-authenticated is acceptable unless otherwise specified).

quotes: Service Catalog: Create a 'Catalog' section showcasing different categories like Suits, Shirts, Pants, and Traditional wear.
Online Ordering & Measurements: I need an online order form ... provide their measurements ...

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a query method to fetch catalog data used by the frontend.
Backend exposes an update method to create an order and returns a unique order identifier.
Backend stores orders in stable-compatible state so data persists across canister upgrades (as supported by the template).
Backend exposes a method to list submitted orders (for development/testing).

requirements.text: Add an About Us section that explicitly mentions expertise in bespoke tailoring and premium craftsmanship, using clear English copy appropriate for a professional tailoring brand.

quotes: About Us (mentioning our expertise in bespoke tailoring)

acceptanceCriteria: About Us content includes a clear statement about bespoke tailoring expertise.
Copy is in English and matches a premium/professional tone.
Section layout is responsive and visually consistent with the site theme.

requirements.text: Add a Contact Us section/page that includes the displayed phone/email, a simple contact form (name, email/phone, message) and clear location placeholder text. The contact form may submit to the backend as a stored inquiry or may be UI-only if backend storage is not implemented; if backend storage is implemented, it must persist inquiries in the backend actor.
acceptanceCriteria: Contact section shows phone and email again for clarity.
Contact form includes fields: Name, Email or Phone, Message, with basic validation.
If backend storage is implemented: inquiries can be submitted, stored, and confirmed to the user; otherwise, the UI clearly indicates the form is not sending messages yet.

requirements.text: Apply a premium, professional visual theme across the entire site using a coherent palette based on Charcoal Grey with Gold accents and optional Deep Blue highlights. Ensure consistent typography, spacing, button styles, and section hierarchy, and avoid using a blue+purple default theme.

quotes: Design Aesthetic: The website should look premium, using a color palette like Charcoal Grey, Gold, or Deep Blue to represent high-quality craftsmanship.

acceptanceCriteria: The site consistently uses Charcoal Grey as a base with Gold accents; Deep Blue may be used sparingly for emphasis.
Typography, headings, and section spacing look consistent across pages/sections.
Buttons/links have clear hover/focus states and meet basic contrast/readability expectations.
No default blue+purple theme styling dominates the UI.

requirements.text: Integrate React Query-based data fetching for catalog and order submission, including loading and error states for: catalog load, order submission, and (if implemented) contact inquiry submission.
acceptanceCriteria: Catalog UI shows a loading state while fetching and a clear error state on failure.
Order submission shows a submitting state and a clear error state on failure.
Successful order submission resets the form or transitions to a confirmation state without requiring a page refresh.

requirements.text: Add required generated static images to enhance the premium tailoring aesthetic (e.g., subtle fabric texture and a hero/banner image) and render them from frontend static assets (do not serve images via the backend).
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are placed in frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced directly by the frontend.
Images are used in a way that improves the premium aesthetic (e.g., hero background/banner and/or subtle section background).
Images are responsive and do not cause layout shifts or readability issues.

constraints: Use English for all user-facing text.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (no additional backend services).
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutablePaths; compose them instead.
Do not implement third-party authentication; only Internet Identity would be allowed, but it is not required for this scope.
nonGoals: Real-time chat, notifications, or email sending integrations.
User accounts/authentication flows unless explicitly requested later.

required: Premium fabric texture background, subtle weave pattern, dark charcoal tone (fabric-texture-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
Elegant tailoring hero banner with abstract tailoring elements (measuring tape/suit silhouette), charcoal and gold palette (tailoring-hero-banner.dim_2400x900.png)

preferencesToAdd: Use English for user-facing website copy.
